text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Tig'ning tag qismi egilgan bo'lgani uchun tig' u yoki bu tomonga og'ar ekan, muzga tekkan qirrasi gam egiladi.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Bu konkichining burilishiga olib keladi. Agar konki o'ngga og'sa, konkichi o'ngga buriladi, agar konki chapga og'sa, konkichi chapga buriladi.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Oldingi quvvat darajasiga qaytish uchun ular o'zlari yorug'likdan olgan qo'shimcha quvvatdan qutulishi lozim.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Ular buni "foton" deb ataluvchi mayda yorug'lik zarrasini chiqarish orqali amalga oshirishdi.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Olimlar ushbu jarayonni "qo'zg'atilgan nurlanish emissiyasi" den ataydi, chunki atomlar kuchli yorug'lik bilan qo'zg'atilib, foton nuri chiqishiga sabab bo'ladi, nur esa nurlanishning bir turidir.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Keyingi suratda foton chiqarayotgan atomlar tasvirlangan. Albatta, aslida fotonlar suratdagidan ko'ra ancha kichik.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Fotonlar atomlarni tashkil qiluvchi narsalardan ham maydaroq!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Bir nech yuz soatlik faoliyatdan keyin lampochkadagi tolalar oxir-oqibat kuyadi va elektr lampa ishlamay qoladi.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: So'ng lampochkani almashtirish talab qilinadi. Lampochkani almashtirishda ehtiyot bo'lish zarur.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Dastlab, chiroqning elektr kalitini o'chirish yoki kabelni uzish kerak.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Buning sababi shuki, lampochkaning metall qismi turuvchi rozetkaga boradigan elektr toki, agar u hali ham qisman rozetkada bo'lganda rozetkaning ichiga yoki lampochkaning metall asosiga tegsangiz, sizni kuchli tok urishi mumkin.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Qon haydovchi yurak qon aylanish tizimining asosiy organi hisoblanadi.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Qon arteriyalar deb ataluvchi tomirlar orqali yurakdan chiqib ketadi va venalar deb ataluvchi tomirlar orqali yurakka qaytib keladi. Eng kichik tomirlar kapillyarlar deb ataladi.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Triseratopning tishlari nafaqat barglarni, balki nihoyatda qattiq shoxlar va ildizlarni ham eza olgan bo'lardi.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Ba'zi olimlarning fikriga ko'ra, Triseratoplar bo'r davrida keng tarqalgan o'simlik turidan biri sanalgan sikadlar bilan oziqlangan.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Bu o'simliklar o'tkir toji, tikanli yaproqlari bilan mitti palma daraxtiga o'xshab ketadi.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triseratoplar daraxt tanasini yeyishdan avval barglarini uzib tashlash uchun kuchli tumshug'idan foydalangan bo'lishi mumkin.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Boshqa olimlarning ta'kidlashicha, ushbu o'simliklar o'ta zaharli, shu sababli, bugungi kunda yalqov va to'tiqush (dinozavrlarning avlodi) kabi boshqa hayvonlar zaharli barglar yoki meva bilan oziqlana olsa-da, ularni biror bir dinozavr yegani ehtimoldan uzoq.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Ioning tortish kuchi meni qanday tortgan bo'lar edi? Agar siz Ioning sathida tursangiz, yerdagiga nisbatan kamroq tosh bosgan bo'lar edingiz.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Yerda 200 funt (90 kg) tosh bosadigan kishi, Ioda taxminan 36 funt (16 kg) tosh bosadi. Demak, tortishish kuchi, albatta, sizni kamroq tortadi.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Quyosh Yer kabi siz qadam bosishingiz mumkin bo'lgan qobiqqa ega emas. Quyosh butunlay gazlar, olov va plazmadan tashkil topgan.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Quyosh markazidan uzoqlashganingiz sari gaz siyraklashib boradi.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Quyoshga qaraganimizda biz ko'rgan tashqi qism "yorug'lik shari" fotosfera deb nomlanadi va "yorug'lik shari" degan ma'noni anglatadi.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Taxminan uch ming yil o'tib, 1610-yilda, italiyalik astronom Galelio Galiley, oyda bo'lgani kabi Venerada ham fazalar borligini tekshirish uchun teleskopdan foydalangan.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Fazalar faqat Veneraning (yoki Oyning) quyoshga yuzlangan tarafi yoritilgani uchun sodir bo'ladi. Veneraning fazalari sayyoralarning quyosh atrofida aylanishi to'g'risidagi Kopernik nazariyasini qo'llab-quvvatladi.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: So'ng, bir qancha yil o'tgach, 1639-yili Jeremiya Horroks ismli ingliz astronomi Venera tranzitini kuzatadi.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Denloni qayta zabt etganidan so'ng Angliyada uzoq vaqt tinchlik hukm surdi.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Biroq 991-yilda Ezelred bir asr oldingi Gutrum davridan beri boshqalariga qaraganda kattaroq bo'lgan Vikinglar floti bilan to'qnashdi.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Mazkur flotga o'z mamlakatini Daniya hukmronligi ostidan qaytarib olishni maqsad qilgan norvegiyalik Olaf Trigvasson boshchilik qilgan.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Dastlabki harbiy muvaffaqiyatsizliklardan keyin Ezelred Norvegiyaga qaytib, qirolligini birgalikdagi muvaffaqiyat orqali qo'lga kiritishga urinayotgan Olaf bilan shartlarni kelishishga erishdi.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangul — xalq har kuni foydalanadigan atayin ixtiro qilingan yagona alifbo. Alifbo 1444-yilda qirol Sejong (1418–1450) hukmronligi davrida ixtiro qilingan.
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Qirol Sejong Choson sulolasining to'rtinchi qiroli bo'lgan va eng obro'lilaridan biridir.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Dastlab, u Hangul alifbosini "to'g'ri talaffuz uchun insonlarga qo'llanma" ma'nosini anglatuvchi Hunmin Jeongeum deb nomlagan.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Sanskrit qanday paydo bo'lgani haqida ko'plab nazariyalar mavjud. Ulardan biri o'zlari bilan birga o'z tillarini olib kelgan Oriylarning ga'rbdan Hindistonga ko'chishi haqidadir.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit qadimiy til bo'lib, Yevropada so'zlashiladigan lotin tiliga qiyoslanadi.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Dunyoda ma'lum bo'lgan eng qadimiy kitob sanskrit tilida yozilgan. Upanishadlar to'plamidan keyin, sanskrit tili iyerarxiya tufayli shunchaki asta-sekinlik bilan yo'qolib ketdi.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit tili, xuddi lotin tili fransuz hamda ispan tillari singari Yevropa tillari uchun manba bo'lganidek, ko'plab zamonaviy hind tillari uchun manba bo'lib xizmat qilgan nihoyatda murakkab hamda boy til.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Fransiya uchun kurash tugashi bilanoq, Germaniya Britaniya orolini bosib olishga tayyorgarlikni boshladi.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Germaniya hujumga "Dengiz sheri operatsiyasi" degan shartli nom berdi. Britaniya armiyasining aksariyat og'ir qurollari va zaxiralari Dyunkerkdan evakuatsiya qilinishda yo'qotilgandi, shu sababli armiya g'oyat zaif edi.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Biroq Qirollik harbiy-dengiz floti hali ham Germaniya harbiy-dengiz flotiga ("Kriegsmarine") qaraganda ancha kuchliroq edi va La-Mansh bo'ylab yuborilgan har qanday istilo flotini yanchib tashlay olar edi.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Lekin qirollik dengiz flotining oz sonli kemalari ehtimoliy hujum yo'nalishlarida joylashtirilgan edi, chunki admirallar nemis havo hujumi natijasida cho'kib ketishdan qo'rqardi.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Keling, Italiyaning rejalarini anglashdan boshlaymiz. Xususan, Italiya Germaniya va Yaponiyaning "kichik ukasi" edi.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Ular shundoqqina urush boshlanishidan oldin to'rtta yangi kema qurishgan bo'lsa-da, kuchsizroq armiya va kuchsizroq dengiz flotiga ega edi.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Italiyaning bosh maqsadlari Afrika davlatlari edi. Mazkur mamlakatlarni qoʻlga kiritish uchun ularga harbiy platsdarm kerak bo'lardi, shunda qo'shinlar o'rta yer dengizi bo'ylab suzib o'tib, Afrikani bosib olishlari mumkin edi.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Buning uchun ular Misrdagi Britaniya bazalari hamda kemalaridan qutilishlari lozim edi. Bu harakatlardan tashqari, Italiya jangovar kemalari boshqa hech narsa qilmasligi lozim edi.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Endi Yaponiya uchun. Yaponiya xuddi Britaniya kabi orol-davlat edi.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Suvosti kemalari suv ostida yurish va u yerda uzoq muddat qolishga mo'ljallangan kemalardir.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Birinchi jahon urushi va Ikkinchi jahon urushida suvosti kemalaridan foydalanilgan. o'sha vaqtlarda ular juda sekin bo'lib, o't ochish masofasi juda cheklangan edi.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Urushning boshida ular asosan dengiz yuzasida safar qilar edi, lekin radarlar takomillashib, aniqroq bo'la boshlagani sayin, suvosti kemalari ko'zga tashlanmaslik uchun suv ostiga shong'ishga majbur bo'lgan.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Nemis suvosti kemalari U-Boats deb atalgan. Nemislar suvosti kemalarida suzish va ularni boshqarishga juda usta bo'lishgan.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Suvosti kemalari bilan muvaffaqiyat qozonganliklari sababli urushdan so'ng nemislar ularning ko'pchiligiga ega deb ishonilmaydi.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ha! Ba'zida "Qirol Tut" yoki "Qirol bolakay" deb ham atalgan podshoh Tutanxamon hozirda eng taniqli bo'lgan qadimgi Misr shohlaridan biri.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Qizig'I, u qadimgi vaqtlarda juda muhim deb hisoblanmagan hamda ko'pchilik qadimgi podshohlar ro'yxatlarida qayd etilmagan.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Ammo 1922-yilda qabrining topilishi uni mashhur shaxsga aylantirdi. o'tmishning ko'plab qabrlari talon-taroj qilingan bo'lsa ham, bu qabrga deyarli tegilmagandi.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Tutanxamon bilan birga ko'milgan narsalarning ko'pchiligi, jumladan qimmatli metallar va nodir toshlardan yasalgan minglab artefaktlar yaxshi saqlanib qolgan.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Kegayli g'ildiraklarning ixtiro qilinishi Ossuriya aravalarini yengilroq, tezroq va askarlar hamda boshqa aravalardan o'zib ketishga yaxshiroq darajada tayyor bo'lishiga olib keldi.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Ularning dahshatli arbaletlaridan otilgan o'qlar dushman askarlari zirhlariga kirishi mumkin edi. Miloddan avvalgi 1000-yil atrofida Ossuriyaliklar birinchi otliq qo'shinni yaratdilar.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Otliqlar otda jang qiladigan qo'shindir. Egarlar hali kashf qilinmaganligi sababli, Ossuriya otliqlari o'z otlariga egarsiz mingan holda jang qilgan.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Biz ko'plab yunon siyosatchilari, olimlari va musavvirlarini bilamiz. Ehtimol, bu madaniyatning eng mashhur shaxsi Yunon adabiyotining ikki shoh asarlari "Iliada" va "Odissey" dostonlarini yozgan, ko'zi ojiz afsonaviy shoir Gomerdir.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofokl va Aristofan hanuzgacha taniqli dramanavislar bo'lib, ularning asarlari jahon adabiyotining durdona asarlaridan hisoblanadi.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Yana bir mashhur grek bu asosan o'zining to'g'ri burchakli uchburchakning tomonlari o'rtasidagi munosabatlar teoremasi bilan mashhur bo'lgan matematik Pifagordir.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Hind tilida qancha odam gaplashishi haqida turli taxminlar mavjud. Uning dunyoda eng keng tarqalgan ikkinchi va to'rtinchi tillar orasida ekani taxmin qilinadi.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Ona tilida so'zlashuvchilar soni juda yaqin bog'langan dialektlarlarning hisobga olingan yoki olinmaganiga bog'liq ravishda farq qiladi.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Hisob-kitoblarga ko'ra, so'zlovchilari 340 milliondan 500 milliongacha bo'lib, 800 millionga yaqin odam bu tilni tushuna oladi.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hind va urdu tili lug'at jihatidan o'xshash, lekin yozuv jihatidan farqli; kundalik suhbatlarda, odatda, har ikkala tilda gapiruvchilar bir-birini tushunadi.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Taxminan 15-asrlarda Shimoliy Estoniya Germaniyaning ulkan madaniy ta'siri ostida yashagan.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Ayrim nemis rohiblari Xudoni tub xalqqa yaqinlashtirishni xohlashdi, shuning uchun ular eston adabiy tilini yaratishdi.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: U nemis alifbosiga asoslangan hamda birgina "Õ/õ" belgisi qo'shilgan edi.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Vaqt o'tishi bilan, nemis tilidan kirib kelgan ko'plab so'zlar birlashdi. Bu ma'rifatning ibtidosi edi.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: An'anaga ko'ra, taxt vorisi maktabni tamomlagach, to'g'ri harbiy xizmatga jo'nardi.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Ammo Charlz Kembrijdagi Triniti kollejga borib, antropologiya va arxeologiya, keyinchalik esa tarixni o'rganib, 2:2 (quyi ikkinchi toifali daraja) ni qo'lga kiritdi.
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charlz Britaniya Qirollik oilasining daraja bilan taqdirlangan dastlabki a'zosi bo'lgan.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turkiyaning Yevropa qismi (sharqiy Frakiya yoki Bolqon yarim orolidagi Rumeliya deb ham ataladi) mamlakatning 3% hududini qamrab olgan.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turkiya hududi deyarli to'g'ri to'rtburchak shaklga ega bo'lib, uzunligi 1600 kilometrdan (1000 mil) ortiq va kengligi 800 kilometrga (500 mil) teng.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Turkiyaning maydoni, ko'llarni hisobga olgan holda, 783 562 kvadrat kilometerni (300 948 kvadrat milya) egallaydi, shundan 755 688 kvadrat kilometr (291 773 kvadrat milya) janubiy g'arbiy Osiyoda va 23 764 kvadrat kilometr (9174 kvadrat milya) Yevropada joylashgan.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Turkiya hududi uni dunyodagi 37-eng yirik mamlakatga aylantiradi va deyarli Metropliten Fransiya hamda Birlashgan Qirollikning birgalikdagi maydoniga teng.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkiya uch tomondan dengizlar bilan o'ralgan: g'arbda Egey dengizi, shimolda Qora dengiz, janubda o'rta Yer dengizi joylashgan.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Lyuksemburgning uzun tarixi bor, lekin uning mustaqilligi 1839-yildan boshlanadi.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Belgiyaning hozirgi kundagi hududlari o'tmishda Lyuksemburgning tarkibida bo'lgan, biroq 1830-yillardagi Belgiya inqilobidan so'ng Belgiya hududiga aylangan.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Lyuksemburg doim betaraf mamlakat bo'lib qolishga harakat qilgan, ammo Birinchi jahon urushida ham, Ikkinchi jahon urushida ham Germaniya tomonidan bosib olingan.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: 1957-yilda Lyuksemburg hozirda Yevropa Ittifoqi sifatida tanilgan tashkilotning ta'sischi a'zosi bo'lgan.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong — Paro tumanining yuqori qismida (Phondey qishlog'ida) joylashgan vayron qilingan qal'a va buddaviylik monastiri.
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Aytishlaricha, 1649-yili Zabdrung Ngavang Namgyel Tibet-mo'g'ul kuchlariga ustidan g'alabasini xotirlash maqsadida mazkur qal'ani bunyod etgan.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: 1951-yili yong'in tufayli Drukgyal Dzongning faqat ayrim qoldiqlari, masalan, Zabdrung Ngavang Namgyal surati qoldi, xolos.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Yong'indan so'ng qal'a saqlab qolindi va himoyaga olindi, u Butandagi eng shov-shuvli jozibador maskanlaridan biri bo'lib qoldi.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: 18-asrda Kambodja Tailand va Vetnamdek ikki qudratli qo'shnisi orasida siquvda qoldi.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: 18-asrda taylandliklar Kambodjaga bir necha marotaba bostirib kirgan va 1772-yil Pnom Fenni vayron qilgan.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: 18-asrning oxirgi yillarida vetnamliklar ham Kambodjani istilo qildi.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Venesuelaliklarning o'n sakkiz foizi ishsiz bo'lib, ish bilan ta'minlanganlarning ko'pchiligi norasmiy iqtisodda ishlaydi.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Ishlaydigan venesuelaliklarning uchdan ikki qismi xizmat ko'rsatish sohasida mehnat qiladi, deyarli chorak qismi sanoatda va beshdan bir qismi qishloq xo'jaligida ishlaydi.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Venesuelaliklar uchun muhim sanoat bu mamlakat sof eksportchi bo'lgan neft sanoatidir, garchi neft sanoatida aholining faqat bir foizi ishlasa ham.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Davlat mustaqilligining ilk kunlarida Singapur Botanika bog'i ekspertlari orolni tropik bog' shaharga aylantirishga ko'maklashdilar.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: 1981-yili orxideya gibridi bo'lgan Vanda Miss Joakim xalqning milliy guli sifatida tanlab olindi.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Har yili oktyabr atrofida qariyb 1,5 million o'txo'r hayvonlar yomg'ir uchun shimoliy tepaliklardan Mara daryosini kechib o'tib, janubiy tekisliklar tomon safar qiladi.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Va keyin aprel oyidagi yomg'irdan so'ng g'arb orqali, yana Mara daryosini kesib o'tib, shimolga qaytiladi.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Serengeti mintaqasii Tanzaniyadagi Serengeti Milliy bog'i, Ngorongoro qo'riqxona hududi hamda Masva Game qo'riqxonasi va Kenyadagi Maasai Mara Milliy qo'riqxonasini qamrab oladi.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Interfaol mediani yaratishni o'rganish uchun odatiy va an'anaviy ko'nikmalar, shuningdek, interfaol darslarda o'rganilgan vositalar (hikoya taxtasini yaratish, audio va videoni tahrirlash, hikoya so'zlash va h.k.) talab etiladi.
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Interfaol dizayn media mahsulot haqidagi taxminlaringizni qayta baholashingizni va noodatiy usullar orqali o'ylashni o'rganishni talab qiladi.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Interaktiv dizayn loyiha komponentlarining bir-birlariga bog'lanishlarini, biroq alohida element sifatida ma'noga ega bo'lishlarini ham talab qiladi.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Yaqinlashtiruvchi linzalarning asosiy noqulayligi shundan iboratki, fokusning murakkabligi va fokus masofasiga erishish uchun talab qilingan linza elementlari soni asosiy fokusli linzalarga qaraganda ancha katta bo'ladi.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Obyektiv ishlab chiqaruvchilarning obyektiv ishlab chiqarishda erishgan yuqori standartlari tufayli bu tobora arzimas muammoga aylanib bormoqda.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Bu yaqinlashtirish linzalari o'zgarmas fokusli linzalar yordamida erishilgan natija bilan taqqoslanadigan rasmlar yaratish imkonini beradi.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Yaqinlashtiruvchi obyektivlarning boshqa bir kamchiligi shundaki, obyektivning maksimal diafragmasi (tezligi) odatda pastroq bo'ladi.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Bu yorug'lik kam bo'lgan sharoitlarda arzon kattalashtiruvchi linzalardan chaqnoqsiz foydalanishni qiyinlashtiradi.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Kinofilmni DVD formatiga aylantirishda eng ko'p uchraydigan muammolardan biri bu tasvirni ortiqcha yoyib yuborishdir.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Ko'pchilik televideniyelar keng ommaga yoqadigan tarzda tayyorlanadi.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Ana shu sababli siz televizorda ko'radigan barcha narsalar yuqoridan, pastdan va yon tomonlardan kesilgan chegaralarga ega bo'ladi.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Bu tasvir ekranni to'liq qoplashini ta'minlash uchun qilingan. Bu overskan deyiladi.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Afsuski, DVDga yozganingizda uning chetlari ham kesilishi mumkin, agar videoda taglavha tag qismga juda yaqin joylashgan bo'lsa, ular ko'rinmaydi.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: An'anaviy o'rta asrlar qal'asi ritsarlar turnirlari, banketlar va Artur rutsarligini qiyofalantirgan holda uzoq vaqtlar tasavvurlarni ilhomlantirib keldi.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Hattoki ming yillik eski harobalar orasida turib ham uzoq o'tmishda o''tib ketgan janglarning tovushlari va hidlarini tasavvur qilish, toshlar ustida tuyoqlarning yurishlarini deyarli eshitish va zindon ostidan ko'tarilayotgan qo'rquvni sezish mumkin.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Biroq bizning tasavvurimiz haqiqatga asoslanganmi? Nega birinchi navbatda qasrlar qurilgan? Ular qanday qilib loyihalashtirilgan va bunyod etilgan?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: o'sha davrga xos bo'lgan Kibri Muxloe qal'asi haqiqiy qal'adan ko'ra, ko'proq mustahkamligi oshirilgan uydir.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Uning katta oynaband derazalari va ingichka devori keskin hujumga uzoq dosh berolmagan bo'lardi.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: 1480-yillarda qurilishi Lord Gastings tomonidan boshlangan vaqtda mamlakat nisbatan tinch bo'lgan va mudofaa izg'ib yurgan mayda qaroqchilar to'dalariga qarshi talab qilingan xolos.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Kuchlar muvozanati Yevropa mamlakatlari barcha Yevropa davlatlarining milliy suverenitetini saqlashga harakat qilgan tizim edi.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Konsepsiya Yevropaning barcha davlatlari bir davlatning qudratli bo'lishing oldini olishga intilishlaridan iborat edi va shu tarzda milliy hukumatlar muvozanatni saqlash maqsadida o'z ittifoqlarini tez-tez o'zgartirib turardilar.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Ispaniya merosi uchun urush kuchlar muvozanati asosiy muammosi bo'lgan birinchi urushni belgilab berdi.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Bu muhim o'zgarish bo'ldi, chunki Yevropaning qudratli davlatlari endi diniy urushni bahona qila olmas edi. Shu tarzda, diniy urush deb nomlangan o'ttiz yillik urush oxirgi urush bo'ldi.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Efesdagi Artemida ibodatxonasi m.a. 356-yil 21-iyulda Gerostratning qasddan o't qo'yishi oqibatida vayron qilingan.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Hikoyaga ko'ra, uning muddaosi istalgancha badal evaziga mashhur bo'lish edi. G'azablangan efesliklar Gerostratning nomi hech qachon qayd etilmasligini e'lon qiladi.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Keyinchalik yunon tarixchisi Strabon mazkur nomni qayd etgan, shu tarzda biz bugun undan xabardormiz. Ibodatxona Buyuk Aleksandr dunyoga kelgan tunda vayron etilgan.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Aleksandr shoh sifatida ibodatxonani qayta qurish uchun pul to'lashni taklif qildi, biroq uning taklifi rad etildi. Keyinchalik, Aleksandr vafotidan so'ng, m.a.323-yilda ibodatxona qayta barpo qilindi.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Notalarning barchasini to'g'ri bosar ekansiz, qo'lingizning iloji boricha bo'shashganligiga ishonch hosil qiling — shuningdek, barmoqlaringiz bilan tegishli bo'lmagan harakatlarni ko'p qilmaslikka urining.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Shu tarzda, siz o'zingizni imkon qadar kamroq toliqtirasiz. Unutmang, pianinodagi singari qo'shimcha kuch uchun klaviaturani katta kuch bilan urishga hojat yo'q.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Akkordeonda qo'shimcha tovush chiqarish uchun ohangdan kuchliroq bosim yoxud tezlik bilan foydalanasiz.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Tasavvuf — bu yakuniy voqelik, ilohiylik, ma'naviy ishonch yoki Xudodan ongli ravishda xabardor bo'lish, o'zlikni anglash, Xudo bilan muloqotda bo'lish istagining mavjudligidir.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: E'tiqod qiluvchi ilohiy borliq/ma'bud yoki ma'budlarga bo'lgan bevosita tajriba, ichki his yoki tushunchani izlaydi.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Shogirdlar hayotning muayyan yo'llarini yoxud ushbu tajribani boyitishga qaratilgan amaliyotlarni davom ettiradilar.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Tasavvuf noyob ong holatini, xususan, tinch, ziyrak, saodatli va hatto ekstatik xarakterga ega holatni bevosita boshdan kechirishga urg'u berishi orqali boshqa diniy e'tiqod va ibodat shakllaridan farqlanishi mumkin.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikxizm Hind submaterigidagi dindir. U Panjob mintaqasida 15-asrda Hinduizm an'analari doirasidagi sektalarga bo'linish natijasida kelib chiqqan.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikxlar garchi o'z e'tiqodlarining Hinduizm asosidagi ildizlar va an'analarga egaligini tan olsalar ham, uni hinduizmdan alohida din deb hisoblaydilar.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikxlar o'z dinini "Gurmat" deb ataydi, bu panjob tilida "guru yo'li" degani. Guru barcha hind dinlarining asosiy xususiyatidir, biroq sikxizmda sikx e'tiqodi asosini tashkil etuvchi ahamiyatga ega.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Mazkur dinga Guru Nanak (1469–1539) tomonidan 15-asrda asos solingan. So'ngra to'qqiz nafar guru ketma-ket ergashdi.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Biroq 1956-yilning iyunida xodimlar oziq-ovqat tanqisligi hamda ish haqi kamaytirilishiga qarshi namoyishlar o'tkazayotgan joyda, kommunizmga qarshi umumiy norozilikka aylanib ketganda, Polshadagi tartibsizliklar vaqtida Xrushchevning va'dalari sinovdan o'tkazildi.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Oxir-oqibat, Xrushchyov tartibni qayta tiklash maqsadida tanklarni yuborganligiga qaramay, u ayrim iqtisodiy talablarga yon berdi hamda mashhur Vladislav Gomulkani yangi bosh vazir etib tayinlashga rozilik berdi.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Hind vodiysi sivilizatsiyasi — hozirgi Pokistonning aksariyat qismi hamda shimoli-sharqiy Afg'oniston va shimoli-g'arbiy Hindistondagi ba'zi viloyatlarni o'z ichiga olgan shimoli-g'arbiy Hindiston subkontinentida joylashgan Bronza davri svilizatsiyasi edi.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Bu tamaddun Hind daryosi havzasida gullab-yashnadi, shu sababli uning nomini oldi.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Ba'zi olimlar hozirda qurib bitgan Sarasvati daryosi havzalarida ham sivilizatsiya mavjud bo'lganligi sababli, u mos ravishda Hind-Sarasvati sivilizatsiyasi deb nomlanishi kerak, deb ta'kidlasa-da, ayrimlar 1920-yillarda qazilgan joylardan birinchisi — Harappa sharafiga uni Harappa sivilizatsiyasi deb ataydi.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Rim imperiyasining militaristik tabiati tibbiyot yutuqlarining taraqqiyotiga ko'maklashdi.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Imperator Avgust shifokorlarni yollay boshladi hamda ular hattoki urushlardan so'ng foydalanish maqsadida birinchi Rim tibbiyot korpusini yaratishdi.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Jarrohlar ko'knor urug'i ekstraktlaridan olingan morfin va mingdevona urug'idan olingan skopolaminni o'z ichiga olgan turli tinchlantiruvchi vositalar to'g'risida ma'lumotga ega edilar.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Ular kasallarni gangrenadan saqlash uchun amputatsiya qilish, shuningdek, qon oqishini to'xtatish uchun turniket va arterial qisqichlardan foydalanishda mohir bo'lib olishdi.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Bir necha asrlar davomida Rim imperiyasi tibbiyot sohasida ulkan g'alabalarga erishgan va hozirgi vaqtda bizga ma'lum bilimlarning katta qismini shakllantirdi.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pyurlend origami — bu bir vaqtning o'zida faqat bitta buklama bajarilishi mumkin bo'lgan, teskari buklamalar kabi murakkab buklamalarga yo'l qo'yilmaydigan va barcha buklamalar oddiy o'ringa ega bo'lgan origamidir.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: U tajribasiz buklovchilarga yoxud harakatlanish ko'nikmalari cheklanganlarga ko'mak berish maqsadida 1970-yillarda Jon Smit tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Irq va irqiy stereotiplar haqida tushuncha yosh bolalarda juda erta shakllanadi va mazkur irqiy stereotiplar xulq-atvorga ta'sir o'tkazadi.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Masalan, o'zini "maktabda yaxshi o'qimaydi" stereotipi bilan qaraladigan irqiy ozchilikka mansub deb bilgan bolalar o'zlarining irqiga oid stereotip haqida eshitganidan so'ng maktabda yaxshi o'qimay qo'yishga moyil bo'lgan.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace Qo'shma Shtatlarda foydalaniladigan uchinchi eng mashhur sayt hisoblanadi va ayni vaqtda 54 millionta profilga ega.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Bu veb-saytlar, xususan, ta'lim muassasalarida yuqori e'tibor qozondi.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Mazkur veb-saytlar ijobiy jihatlarga ega, jumladan, bloglar, videolar, rasmlar va boshqa xususiyatlarni o'z ichiga olgan sinf sahifasini osongina o'rnata oladi.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Mazkur sahifaga birgina veb-manzilni ko'rsatish orqali osongina kirish mumkin, bu klaviaturadan foydalanish yoki imloda muammolari bor talabalar uchun yozish va eslab qolishni osonlashtiradi.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Uni o'qishni osonlashtirish, shuningdek kerakli darajada ko'proq yoki kamroq rangli qilib sozlash mumkin.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Diqqatni jamlay olmaslik buzilishi "bu nevrologik sindrom bo'lib, uning klassik aniqlovchi alomatlari impulsivlik, chalg'ituvchanlik va giperfaollik yoki ortiqcha energiyani o'z ichiga oladi".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Bu o'rganishga layoqatsizlik emas, bu o'rganish faoliyatidagi buzilish; bu "barcha bolalarning 3–5 foizi, ehtimol, qariyb 2 million amerikalik bolalarga ta'sir o'tkazadi".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: ADDga yo'liqqan bolalar o'qish mashg'ulotlari kabi narsalarga diqqat jamlashga qiynaladi, lekin ular o'yinlar o'ynash yoki sevimli multfilmlarini tomosha qilish yoxud gaplarni tinish belgilarisiz yozish kabi narsalarga diqqatini jamlay oladi.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Ushbu bolalar odatda ko'p muammolarga duch keladi, chunki ular o'zlarining ongini odatiy usullar bilan rag'batlantira olmaganliklari uchun rag'batlantirish maqsadida "qaltis xatti-harakatlarda ishtirok etishadi, janjallarga kirishishadi va hokimiyatga qarshi chiqishadi".
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD boshqa tengdoshlar bilan munosabatlarga ta'sir qiladi, chunki boshqa bolalar ularning o'zlarini nega bunday tutishini yoki nega bunday talaffuz qilishini yoxud ularning yetuklik darajasi boshqacha ekanini tushuna olmaydilar.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Bilim olish hamda o'rganish slohiyati yuqorida tilga olinganidek o'zgargani tufayli, bilim olishning bazaviy darajasi ham o'zgargan.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Axborot olish bo'yicha yondashuv boshqacha edi. Individual eslash vaqtida ortiq bosim bo'lmas edi, biroq matnni eslash qobiliyatiga ko'proq e'tibor qaratila boshlagandi.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Aslini olganda, Uyg'onish davri o'rganish hamda bilim berishga nisbatan bo'lgan yondashuvda katta o'zgarishlar qildi.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Boshqa primatlardan farqli ravishda, gominidlar siljish yoki vaznini ko'tarish yoxud daraxtlar oralab o'tishda ortiq qo'llaridan foydalanmaydi.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Shimpanzening qo'l va oyoq kaftlari o'lcham va uzunlik jihatidan bir xil, bu qo'lning bo'g'imda yurish paytida og'irlikni ko'tarish uchun foydalanilishida aks etadi.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Inson qo'li tekisroq bo'g'imlarga ega bo'lib, oyoqdan kaltaroqdir.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Yoshi ikki milliondan uch million yilgacha bo'lgan qo'l suyagi topilmalari qo'lning ixtisoslashuvi yurishdan qo'l mehnatiga ko'chganini ko'rsatadi.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Ayrim kishilar tez-tez sun'iy ravishda qo'zg'atilgan ongli tushlarni ko'rish juda ham toliqtirishi mumkin deb hisoblaydi.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Bu hodisaning asosiy sababi REM fazasi o'rtasidagi vaqt uzunligini kengaytiruvchi ongli tushlarning natijasidir.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Har tuniga kamroq sondagi REM lar bilan siz haqiqiy uyquni boshingizdan kechiradigan va tanangiz qayta tiklanadigan bu holat muammoga aylanish uchun yetarli darajada kamroq bo'lib boradi.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Bu go'yoki har yigirma yoki o'ttiz daqiqada uyg'onib, televizor ko'rish kabi toliqtiradi.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Natija sizning miyangizning bir kechada qanchalik aniq tush ko'rishga urinishiga bog'liq.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Shimoliy Amerikada italiyaliklarning ishlari deyarli boshidanoq o'ngidan kelmadi. 1940-yilning 10-iyunida Italiya urush e'lon qilgandan bir hafta o'tib, Britaniyaning 11-gussarlar polki Liviyadagi Kapuzzo qal'asini qo'lga oldi.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Bardiya sharqidagi pistirmada britaniyaliklar italyanlarning o'ninchi armiyasi bosh muhandisi Genaral Lastuchchini qo'lga oldi.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: 28-iyun kuni Liviya general-gubernatori va Mussolinining mo'ljaldagi vorisi — marshal Italo Balbo Tobrukka qo'nish paytida o'z tarafdorlarining yanglish o't ochishi natijasida halok bo'ldi.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Zamonaviy qilichbozlik sporti universitetda tahsil olayotgan talabalardan tortib, professional va Olimpiada o'yinlarigacha ko'plab darajalarda o'ynaladi.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Bu sport asosan duel shaklida o'ynaladi, bir qilichboz boshqasi bilan jang qiladi.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golf — bu o'yinchilar koptoklarni urib, chuqurchalarga tushirish uchun klyushkalardan foydalanadigan o'yindir.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Odatiy raund davomida o'n sakkizta chuqurcha o'ynaladi, o'yinchilar odatda yo'lakdagi birinchi chuqurchadan boshlashadi va o'n sakkizinchisida tugatishadi.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Bosqichni yakunlash uchun eng kam chavgon zarbalari yoxud tebranishlaridan foydalangan o'yinchi g'alaba qiladi.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: o'yin o't ustida o'ynaladi va chuqurcha atrofidagi o'tlar qisqaroq qilib o'rilib, yashil deb nom beriladi.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Ehtimol, turizmning eng keng tarqalgan turi bu aksariyat odamlar sayohat bilan bog'laydigan rekreatsion turizmdir.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Bu kishilarning odatiy kundalik hayot tarzidan ancha farqli bo'lgan yerga dam olish hamda ko'ngil ochish uchun borishidir.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Plyajlar, mavzuli parklar va lager maydonlari ko'pincha hordiq chiqaruvchi sayyohlar tez-tez tashrif buyuradigan eng ommabop joylardir.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Agar muayyan joyga tashrif buyurishdan maqsad uning tarixi hamda madaniyati bilan tanishish bo'lsa, unda turizmning mazkur turi madaniy turizm deb ataladi.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Sayohatchilar muayyan davlatning turli diqqatga sazovor manzillariga tashrif buyurishlari yoxud shunchaki faqat bitta hududga e'tibor qaratishni afzal ko'rishlari mumkin.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Mazkur faoliyatni ko'rgach, mustamlakachilar ham qo'shimcha kuchlarni chaqirdi.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Oldingi pozitsiyalarni mustahkamlovchi qo'shinlar polkovniklar Jon Stark va Jeyms Rid (har ikkalasi ham keyinchalik general bo'lishgan) qo'l ostilaridagi 200 kishidan iborat 1 va 3-polklarni o'z ichiga oldi.
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Starkning odamlari mustamlakachi pozitsiyasining shimoliy yakunidagi panjara bo'ylab o'z o'rinlarini egalladilar.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Quyi oqim yarimorolning shimoli-sharqi bo'ylab Mistik daryo yoqalab bo'shliq ochganida, ular tezda to'siqni qisqa tosh devor bilan kichik sohildagi suv havzasining shimoliy chekkasiga qadar kengaytirishdi.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridli yoki Stark to'siq oldiga taxminan 100 fut (30 m) masofada ustun o'rnatib, oddiy odamlar o'tib ketgunicha hech kim o't ochmasligini buyurdi.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Amerikaning rejasi uchta turli yo'nalishdan muvofiqlashtirilgan hamlalarni amalga oshirishga asoslangandi.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: General Jon Kadvalder har qanday qo'shimcha vositalarni to'sib qo'yish uchun Bordentaundagi ingliz garnizoniga qarshi chalg'ituvchi hujum boshlaydi.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: General Jeyms Eving Trenton Ferridagi daryodan 700 nafar militsiyani olib o'tdi, Assunpink daryosi ustidagi ko'prikni qo'lga kiritdi hamda hech bir dushman qo'shinining qochib qolishiga yo'l qo'ymadi.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: 2400 kishilik asosiy hujum kuchi Trentondan to'qqiz mil shimoldagi daryodan kesib o'tib, so'ng biri Grin qo'l ostida hamda yana biri Sallivan qo'l ostida tong otishiga yaqin hujum boshlash maqsadida ikki guruhga bo'lingan.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Chorak mil yugurishdan yarim mil yugurishga otilganida tezlikning ahamiyatini ancha kamayadi va bardoshlilik mutlaq zaruriyatga aylanadi.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Albatta, ikki daqiqani ishlab olishi mumkin bo'lgan birinchi darajali o'rta masofaga yuguruvchi sportchi juda katta tezlikka ega bo'lishi lozim, biroq nima bo'lganda ham chidamlilik rivojlantirilishi kerak.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Qish paytida kross yugurish, tananing yuqori qismi uchun gimnastik mashqlar bilan birgalikda, yugurish mavsumi uchun eng yaxshi tayyorgarlikdir.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: To'g'ri ovqatlanish amaliyotlarining o'zi a'lo ko'rsatkichlarni ta'minlay olmaydi, lekin ular yosh sportchilarning umumiy salomatligiga sezilarli ta'sir qila oladi.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Sog'lom quvvat muvozanatini saqlash, foydali suv ichish odatiga amal qilish va qo'shimchalar iste'molining turli jihatlarini tushunish sportchilarga o'z ko'rsatkichlarini yaxshilash va sportdan ko'proq zavq olishlariga yordam beradi.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: O'rta masofaga yugurish nisbatan arzon sport turi bo'lsa-da, u bilan shug'ullanish uchun zarur qancha anjom zarurligi borasida yanglish tushunchalar ko'p.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Mahsulotlar ehtiyojga qarab sotib olinishi mumkin, biroq aksariyati faoliyatga arzimas ta'sir ko'rsatadi yoki umuman ta'sir ko'rsatmaydi.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Atletlar hattoki haqiqiy foyda bermaganida ham, ular mahsulotni afzal ko'rishni his qilishlari mumkin.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Atomni barcha moddalarning asosiy qurilish g'ishtlaridan biri deb hisoblasa bo'ladi.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: U Quyosh atrofida aylanayotgan sayyoralar singari Borning soddalashtirilgan modeliga asosan elektron orbitasi bo'ylab harakatlanayongan markaziy yadrodan tashkil topgan juda murakkab obyektdir — 1.1-rasmga qarang.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Yadro ikkita zarrachalar — neytronlar va protonlarni o'z ichiga oladi.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Neytronlar zaryadsiz, protonlar esa musbat elektr zaryadga ega. Elektronlarda manfiy elektr zaryadlar mavjud.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Qurbonni tekshirish uchun siz xavfsizligingizga ishonch hosil qilish maqsadida avval voqea sodir bo'lgan joyni o'rganishingiz kerak.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Jabrlanuvchiga yaqinlashganingizda uning (erkak yoki ayol) holatini va har qanday avtomatik xavf alomatlarini payqashingiz kerak.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Agar siz yordam berishga urinib jarohat olsangiz, vaziyatni yanada og'irlashtirish uchungina xizmat qilishingiz mumkin.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Tadqiqotda tushkunlik, qo'rquv va vahima bel og'rig'idan aziyat chekuvchilarda og'riq va nogironlik o'rtasidagi munosabatga vositachilik qilishi aniqlandi.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Tushkunlik va qo'rquv emas, faqatgina halokatlashtirishning ta'sirlari haftalik qilib tuzilgan muntazam PA seanslarining sharti edi.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Domiy faoliyat ishtirokchilariga surunkali og'riqdagi farqlar va odatiy jismoniy harakatdan noqulaylik hissini ajratib turuvchi og'riqning salbiy qabul qilinishi nuqtai-nazaridan ko'proq ko'makni talab qilindi.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Nigoh yoki ko'rish qobiliyati sezgi a'zolarining ko'rish tizimiga yoki ko'zlarga bog'liq.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Organizm talabiga qarab, murakkabligi turlicha bo'lgan ko'zlarning xilma-xil tuzilishlari bor.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Turli konstruksiyalar har xil imkoniyatga ega, har xil to'lqin uzunligiga nisbatan sezuvchan va turlicha keskinlik darajasiga ega, shu bilan birga ular kirish sezilishi uchun turlicha ishlov berish va optimal darajada ishlashi uchun turli raqamlarni talab qiladi.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Populyatsiya berilgan geografik hudud doirasidagi ma'lum bir turlardagi organizmlar to'plamidir.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Populatsiyaning barcha alohida vakillari aniq bir xususiyatga nisbatan bir xil bo'lgan hollarda ular monomorfik deb ataladi.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Jismoniy shaxslarda muayyan xususiyatning bir qancha variantlari namoyon bo'lsa, ular polimorfikdir.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Chumoli koloniyalar armiyasi turli bosqichlarda ham yuradi va uya quradi.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Ko'chish bosqichida chumolilar armiyasi tunda yuradi va kun davomida dam olish uchun to'xtashadi.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Mavjud oziq-ovqat kamayganida koloniya ko'chmanchilik fazasini boshlaydi. Bu faza davomida koloniya har kuni o'zgaruvchi vaqtinchalik in quradi.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Mazkur ko'chmanchi g'alayon yoxud yurishlarning har biri qariyb 17 kun davom etadi.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Hujayra nima? Hujayra so'zi "kichik xona" ma'nosini anglatuvchi lotincha "cella" so'zidan olingan va birinchi marta po'kakning tuzilishini mikroskopik kuzatish orqali kashf qilingan.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Hujayra barcha tirik jonzotlarning asosiy birligi hisoblanadi va barcha organizmlar bir yoki ko'proq hujayralardan tashkil topadi.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Hayotni o'rganishda hujayralar shunchalik muhimki, ular ko'pincha "hayotning tarkibiy qismlari" deb ataladi.
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Asab tizimi uzluksiz qon oqimini ta'minlash uchun tana bo'ylab asab impulslarini yuborish orqali gomeostazni ta'minlaydi.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Mazkur asab impulslari tana bo'ylab nihoyatda tez yuboriladi, bu esa vujudni har qanday ehtimoliy xvafdan saqlashga yordam beradi.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Tornadolar, boshqa kuchli bo'ronlar bilan taqqoslaganda, kichik hududga zarba beradi, ammo yo'lida uchragan har qanday narsani vayron qilishi mumkin.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Tornadolar daraxtlarni ildizi bilan qo'porib tashlaydi, binolardan taxtalarni sug'urib oladi va avtomobillarni osmonga uchiradi. Tornadolarning eng kuchli ikki foizi uch soatdan ko'proq davom etadi.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Bu dahshatli bo'ronlarda shamolning tezligi 480 km/soatgacha (133 m/s; 300 milya/soat) yetadi.
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Insonlar ming-minglab yillar davomida kattalashtirish uchun linzalar ishlab chiqarishmoqda va foydalanib kelishmoqda.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Biroq birinchi haqiqiy teleskoplar Yevropada XVI asrning oxirlarida yaratildi.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Ushbu teleskoplarda olisdagi obyektlarni yaqinroq va kattaroq ko'rsatish uchun ikkita linza kombinatsiyasidan foydalanilgan.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Ochko'zlik va xudbinlik doimo biz bilan birga bo'ladi va hamkorlikning tabiati shuki, ko'pchilik foyda ko'radigan holatda xudbinlarcha harakat qilish qisqa muddatli istiqbolda har doim ko'proq foyda keltiradi.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Aksariyat kishilar ularning uzoq muddatli eng yaxshi tanlovi – bu boshqalar bilan birgalikda ishlash ekanligini anglab yetadi, deb umid qilamiz.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Ko'pchilik odamlar boshqa yulduzlarga sayohat qila oladigan va boshqa dunyolarni o'rgana oladigan kunni orzu qilishadi, ayrim kishilar u yerlarda nimalar borligini o'ylashadi, ba'zilar esa boshqa sayyorada o'zga sayyoraliklar yoki boshqacha hayot mavjud bo'lishi mumkinligiga ishonishadi.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Biroq, agar bu sodir bo'lsa ham juda uzoq muddat sodir bo'lmasa kerak. Yulduzlar shunchalik tarqoqki, "qo'shni" yulduzlar orasida trillion mil masofa mavjud.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Ehtimol, bir kuni chevaralaringiz begona dunyo ustida turib o'z ajdodlari haqida qiziqar?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Hayvonlar ko'p hujayralardan tashkil topgan. Ular narsalarni yeydilar va ularni ichlarida hazm qiladilar. Ko'pchilik hayvonlar harakatlana oladilar.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Faqatgina jonivorlarda miya bor (garchi barcha jonivorlarda emas; masalan, meduzalarning miyasi yo'q).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Hayvonlar butun yer yuzida topiladi. Ular yerni qazadi, okeanda suzadi va osmonda uchadi.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Hujayra tirik (mavjudotlar) organizmlarning eng mayda tarkibiy va funksional birligi hisoblanadi.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Hujayra so'zi kichkina xona ma'nosini bildiruvchi lotincha cella so'zidan olingan.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Agar siz tirik mavjudotlarga mikroskop ostida qarasangiz, ular kichik kvadratlar va sharlardan tashkil topganligini ko'rasiz.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Angliyalik biolog Robert Huk daraxt po'kagidagi kichkina kvadratchalarni mikroskop orqali kuzatdi.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Ular xonalarga o'xshab ketardi. U o'lik hujayralarni kuzatgan dastlabki inson bo'ldi.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Element va birikmalar o'zgarmay bir holatdan ikkinchisiga o'tishi mumkin.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Gaz va suyuq shaklidagi azot bir xil xususiyatlarga ega. Suyuq holatdagi azot zichroq bo'lishiga qaramay bari bir molekulalari bir xil.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Suv yana bir misoldir. Murakkab suv ikkita vodorod atomi va bitta kislorod atomidan tashkil topadi.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: U gaz, suyuqlik yoxud qattiq jism bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, molekulyar tuzilishi bir xil.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Garchi uning fizik holati o'zgarishi mumkin, shunga qaramay, kimyoviy holati shundayligicha qoladi.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Vaqt bu atrofimizni o'rab turgan, biz bajarayotgan ishlarga ta'sir qiladigan, lekin tushunish qiyin bo'lgan narsadir.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Vaqt ming yillar mobayida diniy, falsafiy hamda allomalar tarafidan tadqiq qilingan.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Biz vaqtni kelajakdan hozirgi zamon orqali o'tmishga yo'l oladigan voqealar ketma-ketligi sifatida qabul qilamiz.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Vaqt biz voqealar davomiyligini (uzunligini) qanday taqqoslashimiz hamdir.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Davriy hodisaning takrorlanishini kuzatish orqali vaqtning o'tishini o'zingiz belgilashingiz mumkin. Davriy hodisa — bu muntazam ravishda qayta va qayta sodir bo'ladigan narsadir.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Bugungi kunda kompyuterlar rasmlar va videolarga ishlov berishda ishlatiladi.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Takomillashgan animatsiyalar kompyuterlarda yaratilishi mumkin hamda animatsiyaning bu turidan televizor va kinolarda tobora ko'proq foydalanilmoqda.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Musiqa ko'pincha ohanglarga ishlov berish va ularni aralashtiruvchi murakkab kompyuterlardan foydalanib yoziladi.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: 19 va 20-asrlarda moalar deb ataluvchi ulkan qushlarni ovlovchi Maori xalqi Yangi Zelandiyaning ilk aholisi ekanligiga uzoq vaqt ishonib kelingan.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Keyinchalik Maori odamlari Buyuk flotda Polineziyadan ko'chib kelib, Morioridan Yangi Zelandiyani tortib olgani, shu orqali qishloq xo'jaligiga asoslangan jamiyat yaratgani bilan bog'liq g'oyaga asoslangan nazariya paydo bo'ldi.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Ammo yangi dalillar Moriorilarning Yangi Zelandiyadan Chatham orollariga ko'chib kelib, o'zlarining boshqalardan farqli, osoyishta madaniyatini yaratgan asosiy maorilar jamosi bo'lganligini ko'rsatadi.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Chatem orollarida boshqa bir qabila – Yangi Zelandiyadan ko'chib ketgan Maori qabilasi ham bor edi.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Ular o'zlarini Moriorilar deb atagan, bir nechta to'qnashuvlar bo'lgan va oxir-oqibat, Moriorilar yo'q qilingan.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Bunda qatnashgan kishilar bir necha o'n yillar davomida qiyinchiliklar va hattoki muvaffaqiyatsizliklarni ochiq baholagan holda kuchli tomonlarimiz va ehtiroslarimizni baholashimizga yordam berdilar.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Shaxsiy, oilaviy hamda tashkiliy hikoyalari bilan o'rtoqlashuvchi kishilarni eshitish vaqtida bizda bebaho o'tmish va tashkilot madaniyatiga yaxshi yoki yomon ta'sir ko'rsatgan shaxslarning ayrimlari haqida tushuncha hosil bo'ldi.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Biror kishining tarixini tushunish madaniyatni tushunishni anglatmaydi, lekin hech bo'lmaganda kishilarga tashkilot tarixi doirasida ularning qayerga tushib qolganini his qilishga yordam beradi.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Muvaffaqiyatlarni baholash va xatolardan ogoh bo'lish davomida alohida shaxslar va butun qatnashuvchi shaxslar tashkilot qadriyatlari, missiyasi va harakatlantiruvchi kuchlarini yanada chuqurroq kashf qiladilar.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Ushbu holatda, oldingi tadbirkorlik xatti-harakati holatlari hamda erishilgan yutuqlarni yodga olish insonlarga yangi o'zgarishlar va mahalliy cherkovlar uchun yangi yo'nalishlarga ochiq bo'lishiga yordam berdi.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Muvaffaqiyat haqidagi bunday hikoyalar kelajakdagi o'zgarishga nisbatan ijobiy moyilliklarni yaratgan holda o'zgarishdan qo'rqish hissini kamaytirdi.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Konvergent fikrlash namunalari — bu yechim topish uchun turli xil g'oyalarni yoxud sohalarni birlashtiradigan muammoni hal qilish usulidir.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Tezkorlik, mantiq va aniqlik, shu bilan birga faktlarni aniqlash, mavjud texnikalarni qayta qo'llash, axborot yig'ish mazkur fikrlash tarzining asosiy yo'nalishidir.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Mazkur fikrlash tarzining eng muhim omili bu: faqat bitta to'g'ri javob bor. Siz faqat ikkita javob, ya'ni to'g'ri yoki noto'g'ri haqida o'ylaysiz.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Bu turdagi tafakkur muayyan bir fan yoki standart tartib-qoidalar bilan bog'liq.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Bu tarzda o'ylaydigan insonlar mantiqiy tafakkurga ega bo'lib, namunalarni yodlab qolish, muammolarni yechish va ilmiy testlar ustida ishlashlari mumkin.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Insonlar boshqalarning fikrlarini o'qish bo'yicha eng qobiliyatli turlardir.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.
